item.title: Abroad and Lobstr team up to bring stablecoin payments into everyday life for users
item.content:encoded:
# Abroad and Lobstr team up to bring stablecoins payments into everyday life
At Abroad, we believe payments should be instant, secure, and without borders. Today, we're proud to announce our partnership with **Lobstr**, one of the most trusted wallets in the Stellar ecosystem. Together, we're making it easier than ever to turn stablecoins into real world spending power across Latin America.
‍
## What is Lobstr?
**Lobstr** is a non-custodial wallet built for the Stellar network. Celebrated for its simplicity and security, it has become the go-to gateway to digital assets for hundreds of thousands of users worldwide. With Lobstr, holding, sending, and receiving cryptocurrencies like USDC is effortless and intuitive.
But **Lobstr** is more than just a wallet. It is a bridge between blockchain technology and everyday payments, created to make digital money as easy to use as traditional cash.
‍
## What does this mean for Abroad?
With Abroad integrated inside the **Lobstr** Wallet, users will be able to use USDC in real life across Latin America and South East Asia. Imagine being in Brazil with USDC in your Lobstr Wallet. At checkout, you scan a Pix QR code directly from Lobstr. Abroad instantly processes the conversion, and the merchant receives Brazilian reais (BRL) in their Pix account, ready to use.
No intermediaries, no hidden steps, no waiting times. Just seamless payments, from USDC balance to local currency in seconds. The same applies across other markets, like Colombia with Transfiya and connected banks, making stablecoins usable across multiple real time payment networks.
‍
## Why this matters
In Latin America, speed and reliability in payments aren't optional; they're essential. This partnership brings together **Lobstr's** trusted wallet and Abroad's cross-border infrastructure to unlock a new level of stablecoin usability.
Travelers can spend abroad without cash, Freelancers can get paid instantly in local currency, and families can send remittances without the usual banking hurdles. This is crypto's promise made real: practical, accessible, and borderless payments.
‍
## One more step toward our mission
At Abroad, our mission is to democratize payments, so that anyone can pay like a local, no matter where they are. Partnering with Lobstr is another step toward making stablecoins a daily use currency secure, fast, and truly global.
‍
📩 **Press contact** Danna Michelle Casas Arango Creative Leader & Design at Abroad - michelle@abroad.finance

item.title: Abroad at Meridian 2025: Innovation, Partnerships, and Growth from Brazil
item.content:encoded:
# Abroad at Meridian 2025: Innovation, Partnerships, and Growth from Brazil
From September 15–18, the iconic Copacabana Palace in Rio de Janeiro hosted **Meridian 2025**, Stellar's global conference that brought together blockchain leaders, regulators, financial institutions, and developers from around the world.
Abroad was there, showcasing key partnerships for real-world stablecoin payments and reaffirming our role in driving digital payment adoption across Latin America.
## A Truly Global Gathering
Brazil set the stage for **Meridian 2025**, Stellar Development Foundation's annual conference. Over the course of a week, blockchain industry leaders came together to discuss financial inclusion, regulation, Web3 infrastructure, and real-world use cases shaping the digital economy.
One of the biggest announcements was the **native issuance of PYUSD on Stellar**, PayPal's stablecoin. This move signaled the growing trust of global institutions in the future of digital assets. The impact was immediate: it showed that major financial players are ready to embrace stablecoins on open networks.
The event also brought together companies like **PayPal, Airtm, Etherfuse, Franklin Templeton Digital Assets, CoinDesk, Bridge, MoneyGram**, alongside a diverse ecosystem of builders and partners such as **Beans, Decaf, Meru, Blend.Capital, The Digital, DTCC, Fireblocks, LayerZero, Anclap, Flip, Anchora**, and many more. Once again, Meridian proved to be the place where the future of open finance takes shape.
## HackMeridian: Innovation in Action
The conference also featured **HackMeridian**, the official hackathon. More than 600 participants from around the world—developers, entrepreneurs, and enthusiasts—teamed up to build projects exploring real-world use cases on Stellar. From digital identity solutions to new models for cross-border payments, the hackathon was a vibrant showcase of creativity and collaboration, highlighting the enormous potential of the global community.
## Abroad at Meridian: From Pilots to Real Partnerships
We came to #Meridian2025 with one clear goal: to show how our platform works in practice and grow alongside the ecosystem.
Ahead of the event, we ran tests and overcame key challenges through our integration with **Lobstr**, ensuring the best possible user experience.
During the conference, we officially **launched our product on ZyptoApp**, giving attendees a new way to make stablecoin payments in Brazil.
Later, we announced our **collaboration with BeansApp**, presenting the integration live and hosting a special activity where several participants won **$50 in rewards**.
Most importantly, more than **300 people used Abroad to make payments in Brazil during the event**, validating the strength of our solution in a truly international setting.
## Real Growth for Abroad
Our participation in Meridian 2025 wasn't just about visibility it also delivered measurable results. According to **Dune**, in September we reached **66 monthly active users**, including **54 new** and **12 returning**. We also processed over **910 transactions in a single month**, with total volume on Stellar already surpassing **200K USDC**.
These numbers show that our work is paying off and that **Abroad is becoming a key player in the adoption of stablecoin payments in Latin America**.
## A Future Already Underway
Meridian 2025 was more than just an event it was proof that open finance is no longer a promise, but a reality in motion. For us, sharing the stage with global leaders, seeing our platform used in real transactions, and achieving tangible growth thanks to community support is the clearest sign that we're on the right path.
Brazil marked the beginning of a new chapter. We leave with strong partnerships, valuable insights, and the conviction that every step we take brings millions of people closer to a financial system that is inclusive, transparent, and borderless.
At Abroad, we believe this is only the beginning.

item.title: Strategic partnership with Zypto: Unlocking instant QR payments for crypto-savvy users
item.content:encoded:
# We’re announcing a strategic partnership with Zypto: instant, frictionless crypto payments for Brazil
At Abroad, we believe payments should be instant, seamless, and accessible to everyone. Today, we’re taking another step toward that vision.
We’re excited to announce our integration with **Zypto**, a global fintech building a complete ecosystem of crypto payments. Together, we’re making it possible to use stablecoins like USDC for everyday payments in Brazil fast, secure, and without friction.
## What is Zypto?
Zypto is a crypto first fintech that enables users to hold, pay, and manage digital assets in real life. With its secure wallet, business payment tools, and global partnerships, Zypto has become a trusted player at the intersection of crypto and traditional finance.
Some of its main solutions include:
* **Zypto Wallet**: non-custodial, supporting 100+ cryptocurrencies. * **Zypto Pay**: accept crypto payments, settle in fiat or crypto. * **Bill Pay & Cards**: pay utilities, reload physical/virtual cards. * **Global integrations**: partners like MoneyGram, Stellar, Algorand, Dash, Gate.io.
## What does this mean for Abroad?
Now, anyone holding USDC in their Zypto wallet can pay merchants or send money in Brazil using a PIX QR code or PIX number. Settlement happens instantly in Brazilian reais, with funds deposited directly to the recipient’s PIX account. There are no intermediaries, no bank account openings, and no hidden costs just real usability, from crypto balance to local spending power in seconds.
## One more step toward our mission
This partnership is about more than technology. It is about making stablecoins part of everyday life. By connecting Abroad’s infrastructure with Zypto’wallet, we are moving closer to a future where anyone can pay like a local, without borders.
